propositions: Test workers race on a shared git index: one worker's whole-index commit can sweep up another worker's staged changes, causing the second worker's commit to fail with 'nothing to commit' and empty stderr.

The per-store advisory lock in _with_index_lock_retry serializes individual git commands (add, commit) but not the add/commit pair, allowing an interleaving where alpha commits the whole index after both alpha and beta have staged files.
The test asserts both workers exit 0, which fails when beta's commit finds nothing staged after alpha's whole-index commit consumed both files, even though both files' data lands in the repository.
The fix removes the shared-index race by having each worker commit only its own pathspec instead of the whole index, ensuring each writer has non-empty content to commit regardless of interleaving.
Worker assertions must report the failing git command name and both stdout and stderr for diagnosability, since 'nothing to commit' appears in stdout with empty stderr.
